artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan for the /sapience command: draft assembly plus a single approval-gated surface picker, no new script, no Agent-tool dispatch.

memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh Rule U caps an extension's EXTENSION.md at 60 lines, and the sapience extension's own EXTENSION.md sits at exactly 60 with zero slack. A plan that adds a new command surface to an extension must therefore budget its EXTENSION.md edit as an in-place paragraph REPLACEMENT with net line delta <= 0, not an append -- and because EXTENSION.md is that extension's declared merge_targets.claudemd.source, its bytes also land in the eager .claude/CLAUDE.md assembly that verify-deploy.sh gate 20 budgets against orchestrator-context-budget.json's eager_load.baseline_bytes. Two independent ceilings on one file, neither visible from the dispatch's FILE SCOPE list.
